children: Sysco filed audited and interim combined financial statements and pro forma results for JRD Unico in connection with a March 30, 2026 acquisition agreement.
Filed JRD audited combined financials for years ended Dec 27, 2025 and Dec 28, 2024 (Exhibit 99.1).
Filed unaudited combined financials for 13- and 26-week periods ended June 27, 2026 and June 28, 2025 (Exhibit 99.2).
Filed unaudited pro forma condensed combined financials of Sysco for fiscal year ended June 27, 2026 (Exhibit 99.3).
Included JRD Management’s Discussion & Analysis for annual and interim periods (Exhibits 99.4–99.5).
Transaction announced March 30, 2026; expected close ~9–12 months subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals.

title: Sysco to acquire JRD Unico; files JRD audited, interim and pro forma financials with SEC
